subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

__Do I need__ finish this work today itself?
solution:
​The correct answer is **'****Need I'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, "Need I" is the correct phrase.
 
• In the given sentence, "need" is the main verb and we know that whenever "need" is used as a main verb then we have to use "to" with it hence, it should be replaced with "Need I"
 
• In the phrase, "Need I", "Need" is an auxiliary verb and the main verb is "finish" hence, we don't have to use "to"

***So the correct sentence - Need I ****finish this work today itself?*
